findings.title: CI workflow disabled; README claims active CI
findings.impact: Release blocker. No automated type-check/lint/build/test/bundle-budget/Playwright on PRs or main. Regressions ship silently.
findings.root_cause: Workflows intentionally archived Jul 13 (commit 25c117184); README not updated
findings.recommendation: Re-enable CI workflow at .github/workflows/ci.yml before public launch, or correct README to reflect reality

findings.title: Web-vitals collector write amplification + listener leak
findings.impact: 5-11 D1 writes per page view; doubles on mobile tab-switch; multiple LCP posts; pagehide listener leak
findings.root_cause: Native PerformanceObserver with per-entry posting and two unload paths both active
findings.recommendation: Batch metrics, flush once on first unload event, dedupe LCP to final, add session sampling, fix pagehide leak

findings.title: disableCookieCache: true forces per-request D1 session lookup
findings.impact: Every authenticated request issues 3 sequential D1 reads (session + closed-beta + profile)
findings.root_cause: Cookie cache explicitly disabled; likely revocation safety, but defeats the cache
findings.recommendation: Re-enable cookie cache with short TTL + revocation check; batch closed-beta+profile reads
dependencies: audit commit history for original disableCookieCache reason

findings.title: 5-minute cron always writes cron_run_events + performs empty sweeps
findings.impact: ~1,152 D1 rows/day from empty sweeps (288 invocations × ~4 statements); 2 INSERTs per 30 3 * * * invocation
findings.recommendation: Gate INSERT on meaningful-work flag; collapse two recordCronRunEvent calls per 30 3 * * *; hourly aggregate rollup

findings.title: Restore-replay issues N readRowById calls (up to 100)
findings.impact: Up to 100 single-row SELECTs on idempotent restore replay
findings.root_cause: Per-row reader on idempotent path while sibling paths use batched reads
findings.recommendation: Replace Promise.all+readRowById with batched WHERE id IN (...) mirroring :3281-3285

findings.title: reconcileActivityOutbox has up to 500 × 3 D1 statements per pass
findings.impact: Up to 1,500 D1 statements per daily pass
findings.recommendation: Batch the verification SELECT, batch the existence check, issue two atomic batch() calls per branch

findings.title: GlobalPresence singleton DO broadcastTimer prevents hibernation
findings.impact: Singleton DO never hibernates while subscribers present; continuous duration billing
findings.recommendation: clearTimeout in webSocketClose/Error when getWebSockets().length === 0; optionally migrate to DO alarm

findings.title: No bufferedAmount / backpressure handling in any DO
findings.impact: Slow consumers force-closed; no backpressure signal; memory bloat risk under broadcast load
evidence: sendJson at collaboration-room.ts:84-90, global-presence.ts:63-69, support-inbox.ts:78-84 all fire-and-forget
findings.recommendation: Add bufferedAmount check in sendJson; drop cursor/presence if > ~64 KB; close row-update broadcasts with 1013 not 1011
dependencies: hosted load test BLOCKED without credentials

findings.title: Virtualized estimate-row style prop rebuilt per render
findings.impact: All mounted visible virtual rows re-render on every parent render
evidence: row-table.tsx:1309-1315 inline object literal inside map
findings.root_cause: Inline object literal identity churns every render
findings.recommendation: useMemo on style keyed on [virtualRow.start, scrollMargin, virtualEnabled] OR custom comparator on inner memo

findings.title: Global AppProviders ships 8 providers to every route
findings.impact: Public marketing/auth/share routes ship unnecessary notifications/realtime/overlay machinery
findings.root_cause: Single global provider tree with no route scoping
findings.recommendation: Split into PublicProviders + WorkshopProviders; remove RealtimeAuthBridge (K-06); dynamic-import ReleaseAnnouncementModal
findings.existing_plan_relation: extends spirit of Plan 026; covers K-05 + K-06

findings.title: XLSX export double-buffer copy + STORE-mode uncompressed ZIP
findings.impact: 2x peak memory of workbook size; uncompressed payload
findings.recommendation: Return Uint8Array directly as Response body; optionally switch to DEFLATE

findings.title: Recipient invitation emails block the publication request path
findings.impact: ~13 sequential email round-trips + ~50-100 D1 writes on request path; UI stalls; partial-commit risk
findings.root_cause: Inline await pattern instead of durable outbox
findings.recommendation: Execute existing Plan 021: route sends through CLIENT_PORTAL_NOTIFICATIONS_QUEUE

findings.title: useEstimateRowUpdateBroadcast is dead code (no receive-side consumer)
findings.impact: Marginal bundle cost; incomplete realtime feature
evidence: exports exist, no callers in src/
findings.recommendation: Either wire receive side or delete the hook

findings.title: Provider-era scripts still reference Supabase/Postgres
findings.impact: Misleading; agents follow provider-era commands that fail on D1
evidence: collect-live-db-performance-evidence.ts documents supabase db query --linked and psql modes
findings.recommendation: Replace with D1 equivalent using wrangler d1 execute + EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN; rename supabaseRoundTrips to d1RoundTrips

findings.title: Performance budget doc references Postgres/Vercel/Supabase-era assumptions
findings.impact: Misleading guidance for agents extending the doc
findings.recommendation: Sweep for Vercel/Supabase/Postgres references; replace with Cloudflare/D1/R2/Queues/DOs

findings.title: Library full-load paginated scan has no covering index for ORDER BY category, name
findings.impact: Legacy full-library load paginates 1000 rows/page ordered by (category, name) with no supporting index; ~10 full workspace scans at Large tier (10000 items)
evidence: migrations 0026 + 0083 confirm no (workspace_id, category, name) index
findings.root_cause: Browse cursor index from 0083 not used by legacy full-load path
findings.recommendation: Confirm with EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN; migrate path to cursor index OR add (workspace_id, lifecycle_state, category, name) compound index with EXPLAIN before/after proof

findings.title: Component-source guard issues 15+ json_extract correlations per propagation job
findings.impact: Each propagation job batch includes 2 guards with ~15 json_extract predicates each over 3 joined tables; scales with components-per-template × active instances
findings.recommendation: Confirm with EXPLAIN; if hot, pre-resolve expected array via WITH expected(...) AS (SELECT ... FROM json_each(?)) CTE

rejected.claim: 12 eslint errors include cascading-render perf bugs
rejected.reason: Inspected each; intentional patterns (latest-callback-ref) or minor
Modest at alpha scale; tighten at public launch

rejected.claim: Static page Worker cache duplicates ASSETS binding
rejected.reason: ASSETS serves JS/CSS/images pre-Worker; Worker cache is for HTML route responses
